ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION |. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the current RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-H in the area bounded by:
the public alley next north of West 38" Place; a line 150.0 feet east of and parallel to South
Paulina Street; West 38" Place; and a line 125.0 feet east of and parallel to South Paulina
Street
to those of an RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Address: 1644 West 38" Place
